mapper.select: SELECT channel.id, channel.response_name, channel.phone, channel.business_license_url, channel.channel_name, channel.cooperation_mode, channel.settle_acct_name, channel.enterprise_id, channel.settle_acct_no, channel.settle_acct_bank_name, channel.deleted, channel.create_by, channel.create_time, channel.update_by, channel.update_time FROM employee_channel channel WHERE channel.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND channel.deleted = 1 ORDER BY channel.create_time DESC, channel.id DESC
